snippet.title: Wartorn - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Stray Kite Studios launches Wartorn in Early Access on June 17.  The gorgeous real-time tactics roguelite is available on Steam and Epic Games Store today at $29.99. A special launch week discount is also available where the game can be purchased for $19.99 from now until June 24.

Players follow two elven sisters as they journey to reunite their family. Along the way, they confront moral dilemmas and battle external and internal threats, all while utilizing elemental and physics-based systems in their desperate quest for survival. 

https://wartorngame.com/ 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1296660/Wartorn/
Wishlist on Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/wartorn-e12425 
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/SdpeTRB8ES

Follow on social media:
